name: William II of the Netherlands
summary: William II initially resisted constitutional liberalization but endorsed the 1848 settlement limiting royal power and expanding parliamentary rights. That settlement preserved hereditary monarchy and tax-qualified voting; his government continued colonial exploitation and deferred emancipation.
